description.value: Blasted Church Vineyards is an award-winning South Okanagan winery celebrated for its irreverent church-inspired branding and critically acclaimed wines, including a Cabernet Franc recently ranked among BC's top 50 and awarded silver in London. The property features a tasting room with a seasonal food menu, regular live-music events, and two wine club programs. Cyclists riding the Okanagan Falls wine corridor will find it a well-known and lively destination along Parsons Road.
